sources.locator: Lemma10.104.2: expected quotient dimension characterizes regular sequences in a Cohen-Macaulay local ring
sources.scope: Exact commutative-algebra input to the generic centered moment proof; no analytic period comparison.

application: Localize K[u] at its graded maximal ideal; degree16 full Macaulay rank gives zero-dimensional quotient by five moment forms. Regular-local Cohen-Macaulayness and the dimension criterion give a regular sequence, then graded localization faithfulness gives the global sequence.
